readiness_key.experimental: A runnable local implementation exists; its method fidelity or decision value still requires evaluation.
readiness_key.host_brokered: A runnable local step exists, but MindrianOS must provide approved external research and/or review.
readiness_key.blocked: The research package describes this job, but this repository does not yet provide a verified runnable implementation.
readiness_key.planned: A design role only; do not offer it as a runnable engine.

capabilities.name: Find Unusual Pairs Across a Research Collection
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a scoped, source-linked collection is ready and you want pairs whose semantic and structural signals differ, with source links for follow-up.
capabilities.network: denied by the engine; model must be supplied locally
limitations: Pair signals are discovery leads, not evidence of novelty, value, or opportunity.
MindrianOS must resolve room references, review connections, research evidence, and file decisions.
Reference equivalence to the original RS package and model evaluation remain open.

capabilities.name: Map a Source Mechanism to a Target Problem
capabilities.jtbd: Use when you have source-linked descriptions of a mechanism and a target problem and want their relationships mapped into hypotheses for later evidence checks.
limitations: Mapping outputs are hypotheses, not evidence validation.
Imported SME source/license clearance remains unresolved.

capabilities.name: Research and Test a New Problem Framing
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a decision is stuck in its familiar framing and Mindrian can supply approved research, source-linked findings, and reviewer assessments for mapping and inference checks.
capabilities.network: host broker required; this repository makes no network requests
limitations: The host owns approval, provider calls, source access, and final evidence judgment.
SME source/license clearance remains unresolved.

capabilities.name: Compare Decision-Sequence Models
capabilities.jtbd: Use when decision traces have been explicitly coded and at least two models are fully specified, and you want to compare their relative fit for research.
requires: At least two fully specified HMMs
limitations: OMM interpretation and feature rubric are unvalidated.
This is not an opportunity-generation engine or a measure of user ability.

capabilities.name: Find and Challenge Opportunity Leads
capabilities.jtbd: Use when you want a room or portfolio searched for candidate changes, with their evidence and assumptions prepared for human review. This full workflow is not yet runnable here.
limitations: The supplied Eureka package has multiple routines, but this repo has not migrated or verified them as a single user-facing capability.
Do not equate legacy candidate grades with validated opportunity quality.

capabilities.name: Check Which Portfolio Themes Are Underrepresented
capabilities.jtbd: Use when portfolio records have been normalized and a sourced taxonomy is available, and you want underrepresented themes flagged for investigation. The full gap-discovery job is not yet runnable here.
limitations: The executable HSI pair scorer is exposed separately as portfolio.find_hybrid_similarity_pairs.
The reviewed whitespace/gap discovery pipeline and its taxonomy/coverage interpretation are not ported as an end-to-end user job.
A gap in room material does not establish external demand or commercial whitespace.

capabilities.name: Find Mechanisms That Could Reframe a Problem
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a problem is stuck in its familiar field and you need candidate mechanisms from other fields for structural and evidence review. End-to-end retrieval is not yet runnable here.
requires: Approved external research broker for fresh sources
capabilities.network: host broker required for remote sources
limitations: Existing recall and fitness code still needs dependency and semantic-behavior verification.
Retrieved analogies require structural mapping and evidence review.

capabilities.name: Plan Research Across Multiple Fields
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a question needs several disciplines and confirmed domains should be turned into bounded research tasks with clear evidence handoffs. This capability plans; the host performs the research.
limitations: The reviewed Genesis implementation is stronger at planning/persona generation than verified execution.
Perspectives are analytical lenses, not simulated authorities.
No minimum breakthrough count is valid regardless of evidence.

capabilities.name: Challenge a Pitch with Evidence-Linked Questions
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a pitch or proposed solution needs a source-traceable review of its claims, assumptions, comparisons, and falsifiable next questions. The full critique workflow is not yet runnable here.
requires: Optional approved graph and research providers
limitations: The reviewed Jason script is a critique and diagnostic instrument, not an opportunity generator.
Percentile and similarity signals are not calibrated market or novelty scores.
The real dense-model branch and room-graph access remain unverified for that package.

capabilities.name: Structure a Review of Competing Interpretations
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a bounded decision has credible, source-linked competing interpretations and a human needs to review the arguments and record an unresolved or final ruling. The full debate workflow is not yet runnable here.
limitations: BONO source package remains unreviewed; no production behavior is asserted.
A multi-perspective debate does not create independent evidence.

capabilities.name: Find and Explain Relationships Between Portfolio Items
capabilities.jtbd: Use when an approved graph snapshot should be searched for missing or useful links, with evidence and explanations ready for review. Discovery and ranking are not yet runnable here.
limitations: Current package is read-only and its dated backtest did not validate top-ranked future edges.
No graph write is enabled in this repository.

capabilities.name: Diagnose What Is Limiting Progress
capabilities.jtbd: Use when progress is stalled and room evidence is available, but the limiting subsystem or next constraint to investigate is unclear. This remains a MindrianOS-host workflow.
limitations: Not implemented in this repository; the host owns room analysis and native command invocation.

capabilities.name: Compare Competing Explanations
capabilities.jtbd: Use when two explanations or mechanisms would lead to different decisions and you need their evidence, assumptions, predictions, and counterevidence compared. This review is not yet implemented here.
limitations: This is not a truth classifier and is not implemented in this repository.

capabilities.name: Gather Evidence for a Focused Question
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a selected candidate has a specific unresolved claim and an approved host research provider can return supporting and contradictory sources with metadata. This repository does not fetch evidence.
limitations: This repository does not fetch sources; it can validate lineage in a host-returned bundle.

capabilities.name: Find Experts for a Documented Knowledge Gap
capabilities.jtbd: Use when reviewed evidence identifies a specialized knowledge gap and Mindrian has an authorized, source-grounded expert directory. Lookup is not yet implemented here.
limitations: No expert directory lookup or outreach is implemented here.

capabilities.name: Revisit the Room's Previous Bottleneck Thesis
capabilities.jtbd: Use before a new discovery pass when the room may already contain a bottleneck thesis whose evidence and status should shape the next investigation. This remains a MindrianOS-host workflow.
limitations: Not implemented in this repository; retrieval and status are host-owned.

capabilities.name: Count Coverage Across a Supplied Taxonomy
capabilities.jtbd: Use when source records already have categories from a supplied taxonomy and you need counts of well-covered and thin areas before investigating possible gaps.
capabilities.network: denied by the engine; no external research.
limitations: Counts representation only; it does not run original HSI embedding, PCA/UMAP, or demand analysis, and does not establish market whitespace.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Check Whether a Pair's Connecting Region Is Sparse in the Room
capabilities.jtbd: Use after a pair scan when room and reference-framework vectors for the same snapshot are available and you want to compare relative density. This does not establish an external research or market gap.
requires: At least 3 room artifact vectors and 1 reference framework vector
HSI pair results for the same snapshot
Vectors generated with one shared embedding model
capabilities.network: Denied; host supplies vectors and reference frameworks.
limitations: Reports room-relative sparsity only, not a literature gap, novelty, demand, or commercial whitespace.
No embedding generation or external retrieval is performed.
Results depend on supplied baseline choice, vector quality, and corpus size; validate against labeled examples.

capabilities.name: Retrieve Source-Linked Mechanisms from a Supplied Corpus
capabilities.jtbd: Use when the target problem is framed and a local or host-approved corpus of sourced mechanisms is available, and you need candidates for structural mapping. Retrieval is lexical, not a measure of analogy fit.
requires: Mechanism records with domain, description, and source reference
capabilities.network: denied by the engine; remote records must be supplied by MindrianOS after approval.
limitations: Lexical recall only, not the reviewed embedding recall/fitness pipeline; retrieval rank is not analogy fit.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Turn Confirmed Fields into Research Tasks
capabilities.jtbd: Use when the user or host has confirmed which fields matter and needs bounded questions that specify evidence, counterevidence, and a possible falsifier for each task.
capabilities.network: none; research execution is external to this planner.
limitations: Planning stage only; it does not search, generate findings, persist an ICM run, or automatically select evidence-grounded domains.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Group Repeated and Conflicting Research Findings
capabilities.jtbd: Use when parallel research has returned source-linked findings and you need identical claims grouped with their stated support or contradiction positions preserved.
requires: Source-linked findings with explicit host-provided positions
limitations: Groups exact normalized claim text only; it does not merge paraphrases, validate claims, or decide consensus.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Check Claims Against Their Evidence and Falsifiers
capabilities.jtbd: Use before a substantive critique when a proposal has declared claims and you need to check that each links to evidence, counterevidence review, and a falsifying observation.
limitations: Completeness audit only; this is not the reviewed Jason differential-analysis model and makes no factual or market judgment.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Prepare a Six Thinking Hats Review
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a bounded question already has source-linked arguments and you need perspective coverage and open questions organized for a human ruling. This prepares a review; it does not run a debate.
requires: Arguments with perspective labels and source references
limitations: Does not execute BONO research fan-out or debate, does not make a ruling, and perspective labels do not create independent evidence.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Validate and Package Candidate Portfolio Links
capabilities.jtbd: Use after a separate process has proposed links from an approved snapshot, when you need node and evidence references checked and the proposals packaged for human review before any graph write.
requires: Candidate relations with evidence IDs and rationale
limitations: Packages caller-proposed links; it does not discover/rank them or write graph edges.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Plan a Selective Opportunity-Discovery Run
capabilities.jtbd: Use when the user has stated a decision objective and scope and needs a selective method sequence with dependencies and stop points before any capability is run.
limitations: Plan only; the user and Theo still select the methods, and unavailable or unapproved dependencies remain blocked.
This stage never writes to a MindrianOS room, graph, or canonical portfolio.

capabilities.name: Rank Unusual Pairs by Wording and Meaning
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a scoped, source-linked collection has vectors or a local encoder available and you want pairs whose wording and semantic similarity signals differ ranked for investigation.
requires: Optional dense vectors or a locally configured sentence-transformer model for the semantic leg; no dense leg uses explicitly labeled lexical-only degradation
capabilities.network: denied; model loading is local-only and no embeddings are fetched
limitations: HSI and spectral outputs are exploratory portfolio-relative signals, not probability, quality, market, or novelty estimates.
Without a configured local encoder or supplied vectors, the engine explicitly falls back to a lexical-only comparison.
The copied HSI reference source has unresolved redistribution rights and is local-evaluation only.
The whitespace-to-taxonomy workflow is not included in this capability.

capabilities.name: Compare Claims for Restatement and Overlap
capabilities.jtbd: Use when descriptions or claim sets may repeat the same idea in different words and you need sentence pairs surfaced for human review. Similarity is a diagnostic signal, not a novelty score.
requires: One or more text pairs with stable IDs; five or more pairs are needed for corpus percentiles
capabilities.network: denied; optional sentence model must be provided locally; otherwise the output labels its character n-gram proxy
limitations: The semantic/text gap is a paraphrase diagnostic, not novelty, opportunity, or innovation score.
Dense sentence-transformer behavior was not run or validated on this deployment.
Source/package redistribution rights remain unresolved; local evaluation only.

capabilities.name: Screen One Local Snapshot for Opportunity Pair Leads
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a scoped local catalog and local semantic model are ready and you want RS and HSI pair leads from the same snapshot for Theo and human review. The result is a shortlist, not a qualification.
requires: Configured local RS model or local model cache
Optional precomputed dense vectors or local HSI model; without these HSI uses labeled lexical-only degradation
capabilities.network: denied; both methods use local supplied material and local models only
limitations: This combines two retrieval signals, not the full Eureka harvest/critic/qualification lifecycle.
No RS and HSI scores are fused; results are ordered by number of methods surfacing a pair and then best within-engine rank.
Pair signals do not establish technical complementarity, novelty, market value, or a breakthrough.
Theo review, graph tracing, external evidence, SME adjudication, and opportunity-bank writes are separate host actions.
HSI reference-source rights remain unresolved; local evaluation only.

capabilities.name: Compare the Structure of a Mechanism and a Target
capabilities.jtbd: Use when a source mechanism and target problem are each encoded in seven sourced relational layers and you need to prioritize possible correspondences for SME and evidence review.
capabilities.network: denied; encoder model must be available locally
limitations: The layer correspondence and bands are embedding heuristics, not validated transfer or opportunity-quality scores.
Per-layer corpus thresholds are descriptive and uncalibrated; pools under five use fixed 0.5 correspondence thresholds.
A high structural band is an SME handoff hypothesis and must be reviewed against counterevidence and boundary conditions.
No external mechanism retrieval is performed in this capability.
